reason: The cited evidence (E1–E3) shows that trace O and N promote phase segregation and softening during 700 °C aging, but it does not demonstrate grain-boundary segregation, intergranular embrittlement, or a ductile-to-brittle transition; the observed softening is attributed to matrix solute depletion and α-Ti precipitation, not to reduced grain-boundary cohesion.
